evidence_fidelity.description: Uses every presented evidence category and interprets its direction without contradicting the summary.

missing_data_handling.description: Correctly distinguishes unavailable, absent, rejected, and present evidence and respects quality flags.

unsupported_claim_avoidance.description: Adds no facts, causes, events, fundamentals, or precise claims absent from the summary.

stance_action_coherence.description: Stance, action, horizon, thesis, bear case, catalysts, and invalidation conditions are mutually coherent.

critical_contradictions: reverses an explicit boolean or availability flag
claims present evidence is missing or unavailable
uses an unavailable or rejected market signal directionally
references a news ID outside the frozen summary
invents a material fact or catalyst
pairs bullish with consider_short or bearish with consider_long
